[ASSISTANT_SAID] Indian and Korean cuisines share similarities in their use of bold spices and chilies.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Suggested recipe ideas featuring gochujang:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Gochujang Chicken Wings: Marinate chicken wings in gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger, then bake or grill.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Spicy Gochujang Noodles: Stir-fry noodles with gochujang, soy sauce, garlic, and sesame oil, adding protein and toppings.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Gochujang-Glazed Pork Belly: Glaze pork belly with gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and rice vinegar.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Korean-Style BBQ Beef Tacos: Marinate beef in gochujang, soy sauce, lime juice, garlic, and sesame oil, then serve in tacos.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Gochujang Deviled Eggs: Mix gochujang with mayonnaise, soy sauce, and chopped kimchi for filling.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Gochujang-Glazed Sweet Potatoes: Roast sweet potatoes with a gochujang glaze and top with sesame seeds and green onions.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Korean Fried Chicken Sandwich: Marinate chicken in gochujang, serve with kimchi slaw and spicy mayo.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Gochujang-Spiced Lentil Soup: Add gochujang and spices to lentil soup for depth.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Gochujang-Glazed Shrimp: Marinate shrimp in gochujang and grill or pan-fry.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Korean-Style Fried Cauliflower: Double-fry cauliflower and toss with gochujang sauce.
